item.title: about
item.description:
I’m an engineering student and, depending on the week, a founder, a tinkerer, or someone who’s fallen down a Dostoevsky-shaped hole again.

I run a small consulting outfit that gets local businesses online, and I spend the rest of my time on power converter theory, Godot, and whatever factory game currently has my attention.

This site is static, has no JavaScript, and doesn’t track you. That’s not an accident.
